name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro Atlanta (club membership)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro Atlanta
city: Metro Atlanta, GA (26 Clubs in 9 counties)
what_you_do: Join a local Club for after school and school break programs. The pages read describe programs for ages 6 to 18 but do not describe a teen only program.
who_can_apply: Children and teens ages 6 to 18 may apply at each location. Each Club has its own enrollment.
pay_detail: Annual membership fee. The join page lists no dollar amount. It says the fee is lower than other youth groups, is waived for youth with Amerigroup insurance, and that no child is turned away for inability to pay.
duration: Membership year (the 2026 after school registration announcement is on the home page)
deadline_text: The home page says 2026 after school registration is open. No end date read.
how_to_apply: Use 'Register for Membership Here' on the join page, which goes to the BGCMA parent portal (bgcma.org/local-clubs/parent-portal). Use the Find a Club page to pick a Club. Headquarters phone: 404-527-7100.
notes: This is a general club membership, not a job or internship. The pages read do not describe teen specific programs or teen jobs, so call your nearest Club and ask what is offered for teens.
